question: What is the meaning of incineration percentage in relation to end of life scenario?
description: The incineration percentage in relation to end of life scenario represents the proportion of materials that are incinerated instead of being recycled or reused. This indicator is part of the Circularity Indicator (CIEnd of Life) and is used to assess the environmental impact of a building's end-of-life phase. A lower incineration percentage indicates a more circular and sustainable end-of-life scenario.
